intake.title: Ayurvedic Formulation Intake
intake.subtitle: Answer the guided questions below to determine the provisional product classification and applicable regulatory pathway.

metadata.formulation_title_placeholder: e.g., Classical Ashwagandha Churna or Proprietary Herbal Extract
metadata.ingredients_placeholder: e.g., Withania somnifera root powder, Piper longum fruit
metadata.classical_text_placeholder: e.g., Sharangadhara Samhita, Madhyama Khanda, Adhyaya 6
metadata.processing_method_placeholder: e.g., Churna (powder), Vati (tablet), Taila (medicated oil), or Standardized Extract

q_use.prompt: What is the primary intended use of the formulation?
q_use.help_text: Determines whether the product falls under the medicinal framework (D&C Act), dietary food framework (FSSAI), or external cosmetic framework.
q_use.missing_fact_prompt: Please specify the primary intended purpose: Is the product meant to treat/prevent disease, serve as a daily dietary supplement, or provide external cosmetic care?

options.medicinal: Medicinal (Treatment, prevention, mitigation, or cure of human disease/disorder)
options.food_dietary: Food / Dietary Supplement (Daily nutritional nourishment or physiological maintenance)
options.cosmetic: Cosmetic (External cleansing, beautifying, perfuming, or enhancing appearance)

q_ingr.prompt: Are all active botanical and mineral ingredients listed in First Schedule classical Ayurvedic texts?
q_ingr.help_text: First Schedule to the Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940 contains 54 authoritative Ayurvedic treatises (e.g., Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita, API).
q_ingr.missing_fact_prompt: Please confirm the source of your active ingredients: Are all botanical/mineral ingredients documented in First Schedule Ayurvedic texts such as Charaka Samhita or API?

options.all_classical: All ingredients are listed in First Schedule classical texts
options.partial_classical: Contains ingredients not documented in First Schedule classical texts
options.synthetic_added: Contains added synthetic active substances or isolated chemical entities

q_form.prompt: Is the formulation prepared strictly according to an unchanged recipe from an authoritative classical text?
q_form.help_text: Distinguishes classical generic ASU medicines (Section 3(a)) from patent or proprietary ASU medicines (Section 3(h)).
q_form.missing_fact_prompt: Is the formulation prepared strictly according to an unchanged recipe from an authoritative Ayurvedic book, or have you modified the combination, proportions, or processing?

options.exact_classical_recipe: Strictly unchanged classical recipe and traditional processing method
options.proprietary_combination: Novel/modified combination of classical ingredients (Proprietary recipe)
options.modified_dosage_form: Classical ingredients delivered via modern non-classical delivery system (e.g., liposome, nanoparticle)

q_route.prompt: What is the intended administration route of the formulation?
q_route.help_text: Under Section 3(h) and Rule 2(eb), parenterals (injections) are strictly excluded from ASU and phytopharmaceutical definitions.
q_route.missing_fact_prompt: Please confirm the mode of administration: Is the product administered orally/topically, or is it intended for parenteral (injection) administration?

options.oral_topical: Oral, topical, or traditional external application (Non-parenteral)
options.parenteral_injection: Parenteral administration (Injections, implants, or intravenous delivery)

q_food_text.prompt: Is the dietary formulation prepared in accordance with recipes or processes described in Schedule A authoritative Ayurvedic texts?
q_food_text.help_text: Under FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara Regulations 2022 Regulation 2(b), Ayurveda Aahara must be prepared in accordance with recipes or principles in authoritative Ayurvedic books listed in Schedule A.
q_food_text.missing_fact_prompt: Is this food preparation made in accordance with the recipes or principles in authoritative Ayurvedic books listed in Schedule A of the Ayurveda Aahara regulations?

options.in_classical_text: Prepared in accordance with authoritative Ayurvedic texts listed in Schedule A
options.not_in_classical_text: Not derived from Schedule A authoritative classical texts (General food / novel supplement)

q_food_claim.prompt: Does the dietary product label, presentation, or advertising claim to prevent, treat, or cure any human disease?
q_food_claim.help_text: FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulation 8 strictly prohibits any claim to prevent, treat, or cure any human disease in labelling, presentation, or advertising.
q_food_claim.missing_fact_prompt: Please verify your marketing and labelling claims: Does the product claim to prevent, treat, or cure any human disease in labelling, advertising, or presentation?

options.no_disease_claims: No disease prevention, treatment, or cure claims (Only general health/wellness)
options.claims_prevent_treat_cure: Claims prevention, treatment, or cure of human disease

q_food_syn.prompt: Does the dietary formulation contain added vitamins, minerals, or amino acids (whether natural or synthetic)?
q_food_syn.help_text: Regulation 3(4) of FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations states that no person shall add vitamins, minerals, or amino acids to Ayurveda Aahara (Ayurveda Aahara).
q_food_syn.missing_fact_prompt: Please clarify composition: Does the food formulation contain any added vitamins, minerals, or amino acids?

options.no_synthetic_additives: No added vitamins, minerals, or amino acids
options.contains_synthetic_additives: Contains added vitamins, minerals, or amino acids

q_cosm_claim.prompt: Does the cosmetic formulation make therapeutic or medicinal claims to cure skin/hair diseases?
q_cosm_claim.help_text: Under Section 3(aaa) of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940, cosmetics are strictly for cleansing, beautifying, or altering appearance without therapeutic disease claims.
q_cosm_claim.missing_fact_prompt: Please clarify cosmetic claims: Is the product solely for cleansing, perfuming, or beautifying, or does it claim therapeutic cure for dermatological disease?

options.external_cleansing_beautifying: Purely external application for cleansing, beautifying, or altering appearance
options.claims_cure_disease: Claims therapeutic treatment or cure of dermatological or medical disease

classical_generic.label: Classical ASU Drug
classical_generic.statutory_ref: Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940, Section 3(a) & First Schedule
classical_generic.description: Manufactured strictly in accordance with formulae described in authoritative books specified in the First Schedule. Excluded from patentability under Section 3(p) as traditional knowledge.

patent_proprietary.label: Patent or Proprietary (P&P) ASU Drug
patent_proprietary.description: Formulation containing ingredients mentioned in First Schedule texts but prepared in proprietary proportions. Strictly non-parenteral. Section 3(p) and Section 3(e) patent examination applies.

novel_non_classical.label: Novel / Non-Classical Formulation
novel_non_classical.statutory_ref: Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940 / Patents Act 1970
novel_non_classical.description: Contains non-classical botanical/mineral ingredients or novel synthetic delivery systems outside established classical ASU frameworks. Requires professional regulatory referral.

phytopharmaceutical.label: Phytopharmaceutical Drug
phytopharmaceutical.description: Purified and standardized fraction with defined minimum 4 bioactive/phytochemical markers from medicinal plant extract for internal/external use. Strictly non-parenteral. Evaluated under CDSCO new drug pathway.

ayurveda_aahara.label: Ayurveda Aahara
ayurveda_aahara.statutory_ref: FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara Regulations 2022, Regulation 2(b) & Regulation 8
ayurveda_aahara.description: Food or dietary supplement prepared in accordance with recipes described in authoritative Ayurvedic treatises. Strictly prohibited from claiming prevention, treatment, or cure of human disease (Regulation 8).

cosmetic.label: Ayurvedic Cosmetic
cosmetic.description: Article intended to be rubbed, poured, sprinkled, or sprayed on human body for cleansing, beautifying, or altering appearance. Prohibited from therapeutic disease claims.

unknown.label: Unknown / Ambiguous
unknown.statutory_ref: Master Plan Safety Gate & Safe Abstention Protocol
unknown.description: The declared formulation parameters contain missing mandatory facts or conflicting attributes. Classification cannot proceed without clarification or specialist referral.

safety.safe_abstention_desc: The authoritative corpus does not contain an approved statutory provision supporting a verified answer for this query. To prevent AI hallucination and misleading legal advice, the assistant safely abstains.
safety.out_of_scope_desc: Foreign country-specific export compliance (e.g. US FDA, EU EMA) and commercial patent clearance (Freedom-to-Operate) are outside the system's verified scope.
safety.clarification_desc: Essential statutory criteria could not be evaluated because mandatory formulation facts were omitted or ambiguous. Please provide the required information below.
safety.unverified_translation_desc: Dynamic translation for this technical provision has not completed dual-reviewer sign-off. Displaying approved English statutory text to preserve legal accuracy.
